title: Knobby Crispy Vietnamese Andouille Spring Rolls
description: A light and crispy Vietnamese dish featuring Andouille sausage and yuzu cure, diabetic friendly and full of nutty flavor.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat to 350 degrees.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yuzu juice, fish sauce, and rice vinegar.
Add the sliced Andouille sausage to the bowl and toss to coat with the yuzu mixture.
Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface and brush the edges with a little water.
Place a few slices of the sausage in the center of the wrapper, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle some chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds over the sausage.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the spring rolls to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the spring rolls from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the spring rolls hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
